screens.description: Leave empty to fill every grid cell (rows x columns, at most 36). Enter a smaller number to leave the remaining cells empty.

sceneOrder.description: How each pane orders its scenes. The favour orders shuffle with a bias; Fewer repeats plays recently watched scenes last. Defaults to random.

options.label: Favour high ratings and O counts

spreadScenes.description: Avoid playing scenes with the same performer or studio back to back or side by side.

splitScenes.description: Give each pane its own share of the scenes instead of every pane drawing from the whole list. Disabled by default.

avoidDuplicates.displayName: Avoid the same scene on several screens
avoidDuplicates.description: Start every screen on a different scene, and skip scenes already playing on another screen when moving to the next one. Going back or choosing a search result can still repeat a scene.

randomStart.description: Jump to a random point when a scene starts.

loopScenes.description: Repeat a scene instead of advancing to the next one.

pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause every pane while the browser tab is hidden.

markerDuration.displayName: Marker length without an end time
markerDuration.description: Seconds to play a marker that has no end time. Defaults to 30.

showPerformerNavigation.description: Show a portrait button for each performer on every screen, which moves that screen to the performer's next scene.

showInMenu.description: Show the DirtyMultiscreen button in Stash's top bar. When hidden, the player stays reachable by URL.

otherPluginLists.description: Let another plugin's page tell the header button which scenes or markers it shows, such as Cherry Pick's For you. Defaults to known plugins only.

listSizeLimit.description: The most scenes or markers taken from another plugin's list. Defaults to 10000.

sections.title: Grid
sections.description: How many panes play at once.

sections.title: Scenes
sections.description: Which scene each pane plays next.
